name: @merlin/backend
comment: Turbo shim for the Python FastAPI app. No node deps — every script delegates to `uv run` against apps/backend/.venv. Canonical command list lives in the root CLAUDE.md.

scripts.lint: node ../../scripts/check-failures/run.mjs lint -- uv run ruff check src tests scripts migrations && node ../../scripts/check-failures/run.mjs format -- uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts migrations
scripts.lint:fix: uv run ruff check --fix src tests scripts migrations && uv run ruff format src tests scripts migrations
scripts.typecheck: node ../../scripts/check-failures/run.mjs typecheck -- uv run mypy src
scripts.test: node ../../scripts/check-failures/run.mjs test:unit -- uv run pytest tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: node ../../scripts/check-failures/run.mjs test:integration -- uv run pytest tests/integration
